summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing a TR-1 notification of major holdings. The filing reports that The Capital Group Companies, Inc. and its subsidiary Capital Research and Management Company increased their aggregate voting rights in Ryanair from 14.03% to 15.02% as of April 23, 2026. This crossing of the 15% threshold is a routine passive stake disclosure under Irish regulatory requirements, not a special situation. It does not reflect an acquisition, divestiture, or any corporate action by the issuer. This is equivalent to a Schedule 13D or 13G filing in the US but is a routine report of a passive position increase with no strategic implications.
